entities.name: Hamu
entities.description: Minotaur of Hurloon who sheltered Ikenet and became Makura's Consort.

entities.name: Ikenet
entities.description: Pregnant human acrobat found by Hamu who taught him to dance.

entities.name: Makura
entities.description: Great Mother of the minotaurs who chose Hamu as Consort.

entities.name: Herhoona
entities.description: Arrogant minotaur who won the wrestling contest and was executed.

events.summary: Hamu found wounded, pregnant Ikenet in the snow and took her in.
events.quote: he found a wounded, pregnant human named Ikenet in the snow of the Hurloon mountains

events.summary: Ikenet and Hamu performed together and won Makura's favor.
events.quote: earning the Great Mother Makura 's favor and much adoration from the crowd

events.summary: Herhoona won the wrestling contest but Makura still chose Hamu as Consort and let him meet his son Amahu.
events.quote: Makura chose Hamu as her Consort once again

events.summary: Herhoona charged Makura and was tackled and executed.
events.quote: executed by one of the Grandmothers for endangering a Mother and her child

relations.quote: allowing Hamu to meet his son Amahu
